हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Anika Thakur is a college student who has to pay off huge debt to Maddy. In order to cancel the debt, Maddy asks her to work as secretary to a his rival Rich man Vikram and spy on Vikram's activities. Vikram has an incriminating secret, he fights in a illegal MMA club at night and works as suave CEO in the day. While spying for Maddy, Anika develops feelings for Vikram and it creates a conflict in her mind. As Vikram too falls for Anika, how both of them will fight for their love for each other
